snippet.title: It All Began With a Bug - Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
It All Began With A Bug is a short narrative adventure game where you play as insects in a mysterious tower rising above the ocean.

Crawl, mate, dance, fly, push dung and dive into the tiny struggles of fascinating bugs. Discover each creature's story as humanity awaits an imminent collapse, in a narration framed as a nature documentary.

WISHLIST NOW on Steam
